name: xTool S1 40W
tagline: Enclosed 40W diode: top home cutting in xTool's cabinet line
tldr: The 40W S1 is xTool's high-power enclosed diode. Still not CO₂, but the extra optical power helps on thicker basswood versus the 20W cabinet.

priceRange.note: Official xTool store, Oct 2026: $1,699 to $3,049 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Most cutting power in the S1 line: 15 mm basswood plywood and 15 mm black acrylic in one pass (xTool rating)
15 mm/s on 3 mm basswood per xTool: the fastest batch cutting of the S1 heads
Fastest fills in our S1 benchmark: about 6–9 min for a 10 × 10 cm photo

editorialDepth.advantages: The 40W diode module is the most cut-focused head on xTool S1: thicker basswood and faster fills than entry modules on the same chassis.
editorialDepth.limitations: Overkill if you only do fine engraving. Still a diode: clear cast acrylic means CO₂. Plan glasses and exhaust if the chassis is open-frame.

cons: More smoke per job: plan for the purifier or a window duct when cutting daily
Wider spot (0.08 × 0.10 mm per xTool) softens very fine photo dithering and small text
Most expensive S1 bundle: $1,699 Basic on xTool's US store in October 2026
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W SKU on xTool S1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

faq.question: How thick can the xTool S1 40W cut?
faq.answer: xTool rates it for 15 mm basswood plywood, 18 mm cherry, 15 mm walnut and 15 mm black acrylic in one pass, plus 0.1 mm stainless sheet. Those are best-case figures with air assist; our materials list stays more conservative at about 10 mm basswood for clean, repeatable cuts.

faq.question: Is the 40W a good choice for engraving too?
faq.answer: For speed, yes: it fills a 10 × 10 cm photo in about 6–9 min in our benchmark, faster than any other S1 head. Its wider spot (0.08 × 0.10 mm per xTool) makes very fine dithering and tiny text slightly softer than on the low-power heads, so run test grids on your material before production.

faq.question: Is the 40W worth $400 more than the 20W?
faq.answer: If you cut every week, yes: 15 mm/s on 3 mm basswood against 9 mm/s on the 20W per xTool, and thicker stock in a single pass. If you mainly engrave gifts, the 20W Basic at $1,299 (xTool US store, October 2026) does the same engraving work for less than the $1,699 40W Basic.

mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line: engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

moduleSystem.headline: Interchangeable laser heads on the same S1 cabinet
moduleSystem.description: The xTool S1 is sold with different diode modules (10W, 20W, or 40W) or as a bare cabinet: heads swap with two screws and a plug. An optional 2W 1064 nm infrared module adds metal marking without a full fiber galvo. This is not a “hybrid” machine: you replace one head at a time.

standoutFeatures.title: Cuts thicker than most diodes
standoutFeatures.body: xTool rates 15 mm basswood plywood and 15 mm black acrylic in one pass. In practice that covers sign blanks, box joints in 6–10 mm plywood and dark acrylic lettering without a CO₂ tube.

standoutFeatures.title: Fastest cutting in the S1 line
standoutFeatures.body: 15 mm/s on 3 mm basswood per xTool, and about 3–5 min for a 10 × 10 cm cut-out in our benchmark.
